newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on dollar dip.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some business as buying interest was sparked by a dip in the dollar and a slightly firmer opening of nearby Chicago soycomplex futures, market sources said.

"The dip in the dollar saved us from a dull day as buyers started to cover some positions ahead of the weekend amongst fears of tight supplies in the coming month in soybeans and sunmeal," one broker said.
The dollar eased over three pfennigs on the day to a low of 1.8155.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded between $258 and $260 a tonne cif Rotterdam from two vessels.
Nov EU high protein soymeal traded at $268 and Dec/Jan at $259 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $128 a tonne cif Rotterdam, August at $120 and Oct/Dec at $120 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Sept EU rapemeal traded 0.25 marks up at 22.25 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, Nov/Jan up 0.10 at 25.10 and Nov/Apl at 25.40 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
